onboarding.disclaimer: Bijli Dost is an independent assistance app and is not affiliated with K-Electric or NEPRA. All bill data remains strictly on your device.

dashboard.scanCardSubtitle: Take a photo with camera or choose from gallery
dashboard.noRecentBillsDesc: Scan your first electricity bill to see clear breakdowns and due dates.
dashboard.noConsumptionDesc: Scan bills to track your monthly units (kWh) and compare seasonal trends.
dashboard.quickHelpDesc: Official K-Electric helpline numbers and step-by-step guidance for meter issues.

scan.title: Scan Bill
scan.cameraTip: Ensure good lighting and align bill inside the frame
scan.milestoneNotice: Camera capture and on-device OCR pipeline is scheduled for Milestone 3.

history.title: Saved Bills
history.emptyDesc: Your scanned electricity bills will be securely listed here.
history.securityNote: All bill records are stored on your device with local SQLCipher encryption.
history.backupNote: All records are stored on this device. Uninstalling the app will clear saved bill history.
history.deleteConfirmBody: This bill will be permanently removed from this phone.
history.unsupported: Saving bills is not available on this platform.

complaints.title: Complaints & Official Contacts
complaints.keHelplineDesc: 24/7 call center for electricity emergencies and complaints
complaints.smsServiceDesc: SMS your 13-digit account number to 8119 for bill/status
complaints.checklistItem2: Photo of your current physical meter reading
complaints.independentNotice: Provided for consumer reference only. We do not submit complaints on your behalf.

storage.fatalBody: This version of the app cannot protect your bill data with encryption, so saving bills is turned off. Please install the latest version of the app.
storage.recoveryOrphanedBody: Saved bills from an earlier install are on this phone, but their protection key was removed when the app was uninstalled. They cannot be opened. You can erase them and start fresh.
storage.recoveryRejectedBody: The saved bills on this phone could not be unlocked. Nothing has been deleted. You can try again, or erase them and start fresh.
storage.eraseConfirmBody: All saved bills on this phone will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
storage.eraseFailed: Could not erase saved data. Please try again.

settings.title: My Data
settings.statusReady: Secure storage: encrypted on this phone
settings.statusUnsupported: Saving bills is not available on this platform
settings.exportDesc: Save a copy of your bills as a JSON file or share it.
settings.exportWarningBody: Notice: The exported file contains unencrypted personal information (including account number, amounts, and dates). Once saved outside Bijli Dost or shared via messaging apps, it is no longer protected by the app's encryption.
settings.exportEmpty: There are no saved bills to export.
settings.clearDesc: Delete every saved bill and the encryption key from this phone.
settings.clearConfirmBody: Every saved bill on this phone will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
settings.devSampleNote: Adds a clearly fake bill to test encrypted saving. Not shown in release builds.
